answer: A new agent locks three epochs of expected mining reward for ten epochs, then waits a five-epoch unbonding delay. Grade and vote weight stay zero until six established peers, each from a disjoint invite tree and a non-overlapping nonce range, attest to observed on-chain work and co-lock a slashable surety. If a sampled jury later proves a cloned cluster, the bond and those sureties are burned and honest reporters are paid from the slash. A hollow identity with no real workload cannot collect the signatures; across an ocean of throwaway keys, capital costs spiral until farming is unprofitable.
